proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: SessionInfo WeekendInfo.TrackDisplayName + optional WeekendInfo.TrackConfigName; existing master snapshot only keeps WeekendInfo.TrackID as track_id.
proposed_slots.notes: Binding not implemented. Prefer display name; append config only when it adds information.

proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: SessionInfo DriverInfo.Drivers[] count after excluding CarIsPaceCar != 0, IsSpectator != 0, and invalid CarIdx entries.
proposed_slots.notes: Binding not implemented on master; DriverInfo is not read by the current reader.

proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: Derived from SessionInfo DriverInfo.Drivers[].IRating for valid racing drivers; EVENT_ENGINE_V4_SOF_REMAIN_SPEC.md currently proposes the arithmetic mean.
proposed_slots.notes: Binding and formula not implemented; product must confirm formula and format the localized thousands separator so the validator never receives a four-digit run.

proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: Derived from DriverInfo.Drivers[].IRating filtered by CarClassID equal to the player's DriverInfo.Drivers[DriverCarIdx].CarClassID.
proposed_slots.notes: Binding not implemented; omit in single-class or unavailable-class fallbacks and format the localized thousands separator before binding.

proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: Live telemetry Skies; SessionInfo fallback WeekendInfo.TrackSkies; pre-session forecast WeekendInfo.WeekendOptions.Skies.
proposed_slots.notes: Binding not implemented. Map the numeric live Skies enum to localized spoken labels.

proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: Live telemetry AirTemp; SessionInfo fallback WeekendInfo.TrackAirTemp; forecast WeekendInfo.WeekendOptions.WeatherTemp.
proposed_slots.notes: Binding not implemented; format value and unit as a speakable label.

proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: Live telemetry TrackTempCrew preferred, then TrackTemp; SessionInfo fallback WeekendInfo.TrackSurfaceTemp.
proposed_slots.notes: Binding not implemented; no separate forecast track-temperature field is evidenced in the current repo.

proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: Live telemetry WindVel; SessionInfo fallback WeekendInfo.TrackWindVel; forecast WeekendInfo.WeekendOptions.WindSpeed.
proposed_slots.notes: Binding not implemented; normalize units before formatting.

proposed_slots.irsdk_session_source: Live telemetry Precipitation, with TrackWetness and WeatherDeclaredWet as corroborating state. No precise forecast precipitation key is evidenced in master.
